issue.title: Clarify status of different versions at mockito.org and README.md
issue.body:
- [mockito.org](http://mockito.org/) currently lists versions 1.10.19, 2.1.0 and 2.2.5 without any explanation
- [README.md](https://github.com/mockito/mockito/blob/release/2.x/README.md) currently lists versions "latest stable" 1.10.19 and "latest beta" 2.2.5

My understanding is that Mockito 2 is out of beta and only version 2.2.5 should be listed. If that is not correct, it would be nice to clarify the status of the different versions, eg legacy/old version/stable/preferred/beta/experimental/etc.
